worldcombat.skill.sacredfire.summary: Wrapped in a rainbow sacred flame, the user dives into the target for a heavy physical blow that has a good chance to leave it burning, and thaws the user's own freeze. The sacred form leaves a rainbow ember field that keeps burning; the smite form takes one heavier hit.
worldcombat.skill.sacredfire.use.0: Dive through a target wrapped in rainbow flame
worldcombat.skill.sacredfire.use.1: Pressure with a very high burn chance
worldcombat.skill.sacredfire.use.2: Leave a burning rainbow ember field at the landing
worldcombat.skill.sacredfire.description: Dives %2$s blocks along the aim at %3$s blocks/tick, dealing %1$s physical damage on a hit.

Hit radius %1$s blocks; a hit knocks the target back %2$s blocks and has a %3$s chance to burn for about 40 s: every 5 s it loses about 1/16 of its maximum health and its physical attacks deal half damage; Fire-type targets cannot be ignited.
The sacred form leaves a %2$s block rainbow ember field at the impact point, dealing %1$s to those inside every %4$s s and fading after about %3$s; each pulse hits at most %5$s enemies.
worldcombat.skill.sacredfire.smite.on: Smite: power x1.15 and 6 ticks shorter cooldown, but ignition x0.55 and no lingering flame.
worldcombat.skill.sacredfire.smite.off: Sacred: undiminished ignition chance and a rainbow ember field that keeps burning at the impact point, at the cost of slightly lower power and 8 ticks longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.sacredfire.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %5$s s, costing %4$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.sacredfire.growth.0: From level %1$s the strike rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.sacredfire.growth.1: From level %1$s the strike rises to %2$s power and ignition to %3$s.
On: power x1.15 and 6 ticks shorter cooldown, but ignition x0.55 and no lingering flame - a focused strike. Off (sacred): undiminished ignition chance and a rainbow ember field that keeps burning at the impact point, at the cost of slightly lower power and 8 ticks longer cooldown.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers leaping from farther away.
On: low-health targets rank first, finished with this close heavy blow; off: order by ordinary attack only.
worldcombat.skill.sacredfire.description: Casting it also thaws the user's own freeze.
